themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni resigned amid a corruption scandal involving undeclared assets and luxury spending, triggering a major reshuffle in President Javier Milei's administration. The scandal has reverberated across right-wing media globally, with parallel discussions on government instability and corruption in libertarian administrations.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni resigned as Chief of Staff amid illicit enrichment investigations, with Diego Santilli set to replace him.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Coverage highlights the scandal's impact on Milei's libertarian reforms and comparisons to Trump administration corruption cases.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian media frames the scandal as a cautionary tale about far-right governance and corruption risks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Spanish outlets emphasize the hypocrisy of Milei's anti-corruption rhetoric and the scandal's implications for Argentina's political future.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: British media draws parallels between Adorni's resignation and scandals in other right-wing governments, questioning anti-establishment claims.

themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to housing, healthcare, and social services. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, and Hungary, with Vox, Lega, and Fidesz/Tisza advocating for these measures as central to their political platforms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands 'national priority' in regional coalitions, threatening to withdraw support if agreements are not honored.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia push for housing and social policies favoring Italian citizens, often clashing with EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government continues Fidesz's 'Hungary first' policies, restricting access to social benefits for non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN proposes strict 'national priority' measures in healthcare and housing, aiming to reduce immigration's perceived burden.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK advocates for 'British priority' in social services, aligning with European far-right counterparts.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right and right-wing parties in Europe are escalating their attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, with policies aimed at restricting Pride events, rolling back anti-discrimination laws, and opposing same-sex marriage. This theme is particularly prominent in Spain, Hungary, and Italy, where Vox, Fidesz/Tisza, and Lega are leading the charge against LGBTQ+ visibility and rights.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox threatens to cut funding for Pride events and opposes LGBTQ+ anti-discrimination policies in regional governments.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government avoids Pride events while maintaining restrictions on LGBTQ+ rights, despite opposition criticism.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia oppose same-sex marriage and adoption rights, framing LGBTQ+ policies as threats to traditional values.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN proposes rolling back LGBTQ+ anti-discrimination measures, citing 'family values' and national identity.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD opposes Pride events and LGBTQ+ policies, aligning with broader European far-right trends.

The party's rising popularity in polls has intensified debates about its role in German politics, with parallel discussions in France and Italy about the risks of far-right normalization.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical symbols
themes.blurb: Poland and Ukraine are locked in a diplomatic dispute over historical symbols, particularly the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) and its legacy. Polish President Karol Nawrocki's decision to revoke Ukraine's highest honor for President Zelensky has escalated tensions, with right-wing media in Poland and the U.S. framing the dispute as a broader struggle over historical narratives and national identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS government escalates tensions with Ukraine over UPA symbols, revoking Zelensky's honor and blocking EU talks.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media amplifies Poland's stance, framing the dispute as part of a broader anti-communist and nationalist narrative.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian media covers the dispute, emphasizing Central European solidarity with Poland against Ukraine's historical claims.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: British outlets highlight the dispute's impact on NATO unity, with Reform UK framing it as a distraction from broader security concerns.
